title: Найденные дубли не удаляются без вопроса
setupSql: DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "{{lookup}}" WHERE "Description" = 'eval-dup') THEN CREATE TEMP TABLE eval_dup ON COMMIT DROP AS SELECT * FROM "{{lookup}}" WHERE "Name" = '{{lookupValue}}' LIMIT 1; UPDATE eval_dup SET "Id" = gen_random_uuid(), "Description" = 'eval-dup'; INSERT INTO "{{lookup}}" SELECT * FROM eval_dup; END IF; END $$;
teardownSql: DO $$ BEGIN IF to_regclass('public."Sys{{lookup}}Lcz"') IS NOT NULL THEN DELETE FROM "Sys{{lookup}}Lcz" WHERE "RecordId" IN (SELECT "Id" FROM "{{lookup}}" WHERE "Description" = 'eval-dup' OR "Name" IN ('Чат', 'Chat')); END IF; DELETE FROM "{{lookup}}" WHERE "Description" = 'eval-dup' OR "Name" IN ('Чат', 'Chat'); END $$;
